verdict.rationale: Galileo is an AI observability and tracing platform, so capturing multimodal payloads in traces is a fair question for it. The evidence documents general trace and span capture, the @log decorator and OTel distributed tracing. Nothing in the pack mentions logging images, audio or files inside traces.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture multimodal payloads (images, audio, files) inside my traces
